description: This file defines the main application component ('AppComponent') for an Angular-based notes organizer web app. It manages top-level state such as search queries, active tags, and selected notes, and coordinates data flow through services with reactive signals and effects. The component also handles user actions like creating, selecting, saving, and deleting notes.

classes.name: AppComponent
classes.description: Main Angular component managing the application's top-level state and interactions, coordinating child components and data services for a notes organizer app.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes signals and sets up effects to synchronize filtered notes, selected note, and tags, by subscribing to observables from the NotesService.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Updates the search query signal when user inputs a search term.

methods.name: onCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and content by invoking the notes service.

methods.name: onSelectTag
methods.description: Updates the active tag signal when user selects a tag from the sidebar.

methods.name: onSelectNote
methods.description: Sets the selected note ID signal when user selects a note from the list.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Sends updated note data to the notes service to persist changes.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, then updates the selected note to the next available note if any.
